segments.subtask: The robot arm is positioned above the blue object on the table, preparing to pick it up.
The robot arm descends and grasps the blue object, lifting it from the table surface.
The robot arm moves the blue object towards the open drawer, positioning it above the drawer opening.
The robot arm lowers the blue object into the drawer and releases it, completing the placement.
The robot arm retracts and moves away from the drawer, finishing the task.
